description: This file contains utility functions for handling grain storage in Orleans, including retrieving grain storage providers based on grain type and handling missing provider exceptions.

classes.name: GrainStorageHelpers
classes.description: A static class providing helper methods for grain storage management in Orleans.

methods.name: GetGrainStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the IGrainStorage instance associated with a specific grain type, using attributes or default service.

methods.name: ThrowMissingProviderException
methods.description: Throws an exception when no suitable storage provider is found for a grain type.
